# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 6 tokens; Text — 8 tokens; Borders and rings — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 22 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 12 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Stroke — 3 tokens; Size — 6 tokens; Layout — 25 tokens; Type desktop — 38 tokens; Type tablet — 38 tokens; Type mobile — 38 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-page, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-page` | #ffffff | Surface/Page. Default canvas. |
| `--surface-soft` | #e3f1f9 | Surface/Soft. Question panel, quote card, treatment band, footer, resource card. |
| `--surface-accent` | #c3ecff | Surface/Accent. Graphic fields only; no small text other than navy. |
| `--surface-inverse` | #072a59 | Surface/Inverse. Closing CTA band. |
| `--surface-statistic` | #f5fafd | Surface/Statistic. Statistic cards. |
| `--surface-error` | #fef3f2 | Added (not a Figma variable): tinted ground of a field in error and of the form error summary. Navy text on it 13.01:1. Form errors only. |

| `--text-link-on-tint` | #22679f | Link blue for text on clinical-tint cards and white (5.69:1 on tint, 5.99:1 on white); blue #2b79b9 is 4.40:1 on the tint. InfoCard footer links, Quick Guide label text. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 96px/100px Montserrat, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -1px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -1px;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Montserrat-400-normal.woff2`, `fonts/Montserrat-500-normal.woff2`, `fonts/Montserrat-600-normal.woff2`, `fonts/Montserrat-700-normal.woff2`, `fonts/Montserrat-800-normal.woff2` and `fonts/Montserrat-500-italic.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Montserrat-400-normal.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Montserrat-400-normal.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Montserrat | `fonts/Montserrat-400-normal.woff2` (weight 400) | `read fonts/Montserrat-400-normal.woff2` | `var(--font-sans)` | `montserrat` |

Every face: `fonts/Montserrat-400-normal.woff2` (Montserrat, 400), `fonts/Montserrat-500-normal.woff2` (Montserrat, 500), `fonts/Montserrat-600-normal.woff2` (Montserrat, 600), `fonts/Montserrat-700-normal.woff2` (Montserrat, 700), `fonts/Montserrat-800-normal.woff2` (Montserrat, 800), `fonts/Montserrat-500-italic.woff2` (Montserrat, 500, italic).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 0px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-0);
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-0` | 0px | Reset. |
| `--space-4` | 4px | Hairline gaps. |
| `--space-8` | 8px | Tight gaps; rule to heading. |
| `--space-12` | 12px | Small gaps. |
| `--space-16` | 16px | Grid gap (mobile); control vertical padding. |
| `--space-24` | 24px | Within content groups; grid gap (desktop); card padding. |
| `--space-32` | 32px | Within content groups. |
| `--space-40` | 40px | Section padding (mobile); grid margin (tablet). |
| `--space-48` | 48px | Button horizontal padding. |
| `--space-64` | 64px | Large group spacing. |
| `--space-80` | 80px | Section padding and grid margin (desktop). |
| `--space-96` | 96px | Largest section spacing. |
